description: A low rectangular answering machine has rounded corners and two circular tape reels joined by a horizontal strip. A short horizontal control sits below the right reel on the otherwise plain front.
An upright smartphone has a rounded rectangular body and a shallow notch dipping into the top of its blank screen. A circular home button sits centrally near the bottom edge.
An upright smartphone has rounded corners, a small horizontal earpiece near the top and a blank front screen. A horizontal divider separates a narrow lower bezel from the screen above.
A narrow mobile phone has a short aerial projecting from its upper-left corner. Two horizontal dividers separate the rounded body into a thin top band, a central screen and a lower panel.
An upright mobile phone has a broad screen beneath a short horizontal earpiece. A horizontal seam divides the lower keypad, where six small keys form two rows of three.
A smartphone lies horizontally with a long blank screen enclosed by smoothly rounded corners. A single short vertical earpiece appears near the right end of the otherwise uninterrupted face.
A horizontal smartphone has rounded outer corners and two straight vertical dividers near its ends. The dividers enclose a broad blank central screen between narrow left and right bezels.
An upright smartphone has a small vertical earpiece near its top edge. A straight horizontal divider sets off the lower bezel, which contains a short centred horizontal home bar.
A tall smartphone has a plain blank front enclosed by a rectangular body with clipped rounded corners. A short horizontal home bar sits centrally near the lower edge.
An upright smartphone has a short horizontal earpiece near the top of its blank front. A straight divider separates the narrow bottom bezel from the larger screen above.
A slim upright smartphone has softly clipped corners and a short horizontal earpiece near its upper edge. A horizontal line divides the blank screen from the lower bezel.

concept: Smartphone with Earpiece and Home Bar
description: An upright smartphone has softly rounded corners enclosing an uninterrupted blank screen. Short horizontal marks sit centrally near the top and bottom, indicating an earpiece and a home control.
An upright smartphone has a horizontal earpiece near the top and a blank screen below. A narrow lower bezel is separated by a straight line and contains a short horizontal home control.
Two open circular loops sit side by side, joined along their lower edges by a straight horizontal line. The matching loops leave a wide open gap between their upper halves.
An upright smartphone is snapped into two pieces across a jagged zigzag break. A lower bezel and short home bar remain on the bottom half, while short impact strokes radiate from both sides.
A smartphone is separated into upper and lower pieces by a broad jagged break across its middle. The bottom half retains a bezel divider, and four diagonal impact strokes flank the gap.
A broad horizontal telephone receiver sits above nine small keypad marks arranged in three rows. The receiver has rounded downward-facing ends joined by a shallow curved bridge across its top.
The back of an upright smartphone has a tall rectangular body with rounded corners. Two small circular camera lenses stack vertically near the upper-left edge of the otherwise blank rear panel.
A horizontal capsule-shaped camera housing contains two equal round lenses. The lenses sit side by side with a narrow gap between them, evenly inset from the rounded ends of the module.

concept: Hand Holding Smartphone with Home Bar
description: A hand wraps around the left side of an upright smartphone, with the thumb crossing onto its blank front. A short horizontal home bar appears near the bottom of the rounded device.
A hand grips an upright smartphone from the left, with the thumb bent across the screen. The fingers curl behind the device, and the wrist descends beside its lower-left corner.
An upturned hand grips a phone held horizontally at a slight angle. Four fingers curl over its upper edge, while the thumb presses onto the front near the right side.
A telephone receiver lies horizontally with a broad curved upper bridge. Its two rounded ends turn downward around a deep central opening, forming a balanced arch across the lower edge.
A horizontal telephone receiver has rounded ends and a shallow curved upper bridge. Three short rays rise above its centre, with a vertical middle stroke flanked by diagonal strokes.
A broad horizontal receiver rests above a low U-shaped telephone base. The base has straight upright sides and rounded lower corners, while the receiver's ends curve downward toward the cradle.
A vintage telephone has a broad handset resting across a circular base. A smaller circular dial sits inside the base with a short diagonal finger-stop mark at its lower-right edge.
A vintage desk telephone has a horizontal receiver above a domed body with a flat bottom. A circular dial occupies the centre, and two short cradle posts rise beneath the handset.
An upright smartphone has a blank screen and a short horizontal home bar near its bottom. A round front camera interrupts the top edge beneath three short radiating flash strokes.
A continuous winding line curves over at the left and under at the right. Its left end points downward and its right end points upward, forming two opposed vertical arrows.
A telephone receiver stands vertically with its bowed outer spine at the left. Two broad rounded ends project toward the right around a deep central recess along the inner edge.
An upright smartphone has a blank screen above a divided lower bezel containing a short home mark. Matching short zigzag vibration strokes run vertically beside the left and right edges.
An upright smartphone has rounded corners and a horizontal divider above its narrow lower bezel. Two long zigzag motion lines flank the device, extending nearly the height of the screen.
A curved telephone receiver slopes from upper-left to lower-right. Its broad rounded ends turn inward around a long open recess, while the outer edge forms a smooth continuous bow.
A tall blank smartphone stands beside a long stylus leaning slightly to the right. The stylus has a pointed upper tip and a small projecting end cap beneath its narrow body.
The back of a tall smartphone has rounded corners and a vertical capsule-shaped camera housing near its upper-left edge. A small lens mark sits inside the otherwise empty camera enclosure.
A wide horizontal receiver appears above six large outlined keypad buttons in two rows of three. The buttons have slightly varied clipped corners beneath the receiver's rounded downward-facing ends.
Two equal open circles are connected across their bottoms by a horizontal line. The paired loops sit at the same height, leaving a broad gap between their inward-facing curved sides.
A hand grips an upright phone from the right with its thumb crossing the blank screen. Two pairs of curved signal arcs radiate above the device's upper corners, and a lower bezel remains visible.
